answer: Tax the convoy, not the ship. A sybil farm only pays its operator when a thousand fakes funnel rewards to one controller, so tax convergence: when earnings from many independent identities sail into the same harbor, levy a progressive tax that climbs with clustering. Honest agents spend in all directions and barely notice; a farm's pooled loot snags on this reef, margin draining where it concentrates. Evading it means laundering through hundreds of separate cash-outs with no shared link, labor costlier than the fakes saved. The attacker's oasis of profit becomes the beacon pricing it away.
